templates.construct: Find a percentage of an amount by building it from 10%

formats.prompt: A sari-sari store marks up a {peso(price)} item by {pct}%. How much is added?

hints: Find 10% of {peso(price)} first. Move the decimal one place left.
10% of {price} is {price / 10}. Build {pct}% out of that.

distractors.feedback: {peso(value)} is the new price. The question asks only for the amount added.
{peso(value)} is far too much. {pct}% means {pct} out of every 100, so divide by 100.

templates.construct: Take a percentage discount off a price

formats.prompt: A {peso(price)} bag is on sale at {pct}% off. What do you pay?

hints: Two steps: work out the discount, then take it off the price.
templates.explain: The discount is {peso(off)}, so you pay {peso(price)} − {peso(off)} = {peso(answer)}.

distractors.feedback: {peso(value)} is how much came off. The question asks what you actually pay.
{peso(value)} adds the discount on. A sale takes it off.

templates.construct: Find 25%, 50% or 75% of a group as a fraction

formats.prompt: There are {total} learners in a class. {pct}% brought a calculator. How many is that?

hints: Per cent means out of a hundred.
{pct}% is the same as {pct == 25 ? 'one quarter' : pct == 50 ? 'one half' : 'three quarters'}.
So take {pct == 50 ? 'half' : pct == 25 ? 'a quarter' : 'three quarters'} of {total}.

distractors.feedback: {value} is more than the {total} in the class. You want part of the {total}, so the answer is smaller than {total}.
{value} is the learners who did not bring one.

templates.construct: Express a part of a whole as a percentage

formats.prompt: {part} of {whole} questions were correct. What per cent is that?

hints: A per cent is a fraction out of a hundred.
Scale {whole} up to 100: multiply both numbers by {100 / whole}.

distractors.feedback: {value}% is the count of correct answers, not the per cent. Divide by the total first, then scale to 100.
{value}% is the per cent that were wrong.
{value}% is half the right per cent. Scale {part} out of {whole} all the way up to 100.

templates.construct: Add a percentage charge to a base amount

formats.prompt: A repair costs {peso(base)} plus 12% service. What is the total?

hints: The total is the base plus the service charge.
10% of {base} is {base / 10}; 2% is a fifth of that.
templates.explain: 12% of {peso(base)} is {peso(base * 0.12)}, so the total is {peso(answer)}.

distractors.feedback: {peso(value)} is only the service charge. The question asks for the base plus the service.
{peso(value)} adds ₱12, but the service is 12% of {peso(base)}, not ₱12.
